We’re currently averaging 1–2 business days to process orders before shipping. We email your tracking number once your order is packaged and a shipping label is created. Business days exclude weekends and holidays, and personalization can add a couple of business days.

What should I do if the tracking never updates?
If you have a tracking number but it hasn’t updated, please tell me what the latest tracking status says and when it last changed. I can then help you work out the next step.
If it says “delivered” but you don’t have the package, check around your property and with neighbors, then allow 24 hours—it may have been marked delivered early. If it’s still missing, let us know within 5 days of the delivery scan so we can start a carrier trace.
